name: Bariga Malhotra
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Bariga Malhotra is small even for nine, with deep brown skin mapped by old scrapes and one faded chemical burn along her left forearm she got from a leaking pipe in the Blackpipe tunnels. Her hair is coiled tight and usually stuffed under a too-large knit cap she refuses to remove. Her eyes are large and very dark, permanently watchful, the way only children who sleep lightly develop. She has geneware cat-whisker sensory implants — not her choice, inherited from her mother — and they twitch involuntarily when she's nervous, which other kids tease her about.

Bariga Malhotra runs messages between the Blackpipe fences and the Narrows stall-vendors, earning a few Φ per run. She's illiterate in formal script but has memorized dozens of symbols by shape and can navigate the Corridor's maze of maintenance corridors better than most adults. She laughs easily and loudly but goes very quiet the instant something feels wrong — other runners have learned to watch her like a weather vane. She has a fierce attachment to a cracked ELF shrine wedged in a drainage alcove that she tends with water-drop offerings every morning.

core_fears: being separated from the squat kids she considers family
core_desires: to be trusted with harder runs
coping_mechanisms: ritual tending of the ELF shrine
blind_spots: trusts adults who praise her too readily
underestimates how dangerous her work is
psychology.secret: She once accidentally carried a message that got a stall vendor arrested by Ferrogate Transit enforcers. She doesn't know what the message said but she knows the vendor disappeared after she delivered it. She avoids that block.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: sparse, functional, Corridor slang; drops articles often; uses spatial metaphors constantly
speech_patterns.cadence: fast bursts then sudden silence; breathes mid-sentence when excited
verbal_tics: calls everyone 'Auntie' or 'Uncle' regardless of age
example_lines: 'Pipes say rain before midday, Uncle. You want the message go now or later?'
'Pebble finds it. Pebble always finds it. That's why Pebble.'

story_hooks: She memorized a message that contained coordinates she can reproduce phonetically — coordinates someone dangerous wants back.
The ELF shrine she tends has started responding in ways even she finds strange: lights flickering in patterns, the drain running backwards.
narrative_function: Local color and unexpected information source; she has overheard things she doesn't understand but can repeat verbatim. Potential quest hook for anyone trying to reach isolated Narrows contacts.
augmentations: Inherited cosmetic geneware: sensory whisker filaments (fine, barely visible, silver). No voluntary augmentations.
daily_life: Wakes before dawn in a shared squat with three other kids, runs messages through morning market hours, spends afternoons near the ELF shrine or trailing older runners to learn routes.
affiliation: Independent / loose association with Blackpipe Corridor stall network

decision_rules: never run the same route twice in a row
if whiskers flatten, stop and wait
escalation_ladder: run flat out and don't look back

interpersonal_modes.strangers: cheerful but evasive; gives nickname before real name; sizes up exits before engaging
interpersonal_modes.friends: openly affectionate, fiercely loyal, will share last food without hesitation

stress_responses.medium: finds a route memorization task to focus on, mutters pipe directions to herself
stress_responses.high: bolts to the ELF shrine alcove and won't move until 'the pipes are good again'

contradictions: wants to be trusted with more responsibility but panics when given genuine authority
habits: touches every third support pipe along a corridor for luck
keeps a smooth stone in her left pocket at all times
breaking_points: harm coming to one of the squat kids

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian (63.8%) with significant Southeast Asian (15.8%), East Asian (11.8%), and Central Asian (8.6%) ancestry. Her features reflect a rich Pan-Asian blend where South Asian bone structure—pronounced cheekbones and defined facial geometry—merges seamlessly with Southeast Asian refinement and East Asian eye shape. Central Asian heritage adds subtle width to her face and delicate nose bridge. The combination creates a distinctive look: warm golden-brown skin with olive undertones, dark expressive eyes with characteristic East Asian lid structure, and angular features that speak to generations of mixed continental heritage.
physical_description.build: Small-framed and wiry, undersized even for her age. Lean muscle from constant running through tight spaces, no body fat reserves. Proportionally long limbs for climbing and ducking.
physical_description.hair_style: Tightly coiled, worn in close braids underneath a perpetually oversized charcoal knit cap she keeps pulled low
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-golden brown with olive undertones, deepening toward amber in sunlight. The blend of South Asian warmth with Southeast Asian subtlety creates a rich complexion that shifts between warm bronze and cooler olive depending on light angle and environment.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with defined cheekbones reflecting Pan-Asian heritage, the South Asian prominence softened by Southeast Asian refinement and Central Asian delicacy. Dark expressive eyes set with subtle East Asian epicanthic fold, creating characteristic depth. Skin shows wear—old scrape marks on knees and hands, faded dirt permanent in the creases of her palms. Perpetually alert expression, eyes tracking movement with the intensity of inherited geneware sensory enhancement.
distinguishing_marks: Faded chemical burn scar running along the outer left forearm, pale and slightly textured, approximately 8cm in length—memento of a leaking coolant pipe in the Blackpipe tunnels.
Small scars on both knuckles from crawling through rough maintenance corridors.

A thin, almost imperceptible line of fine silver sensory filaments (cat-whisker geneware) extending from her left cheekbone and right temple, visible only in direct light and when they twitch involuntarily.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Fine silver sensory whisker filaments barely visible along cheekbones and temples, inherited geneware from her mother. They twitch noticeably when she's nervous or processing environmental stimuli.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with practiced economy—crouching, sliding, climbing rather than walking. Head held slightly tilted, as if always listening. Goes from loose and laughing to perfectly still and silent in milliseconds when danger is sensed. Fidgets with the brim of her cap when anxious.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 street kid. Oversized knit cap (charcoal, holes patched with thread). Mismatched compression layer under a faded gray tech-fabric hoodie two sizes too large, stolen or scavenged. Cargo pants with more pockets than seams intact, one leg cuffed shorter where a burn melted the original hem. Worn synthetic sneakers held together with e-tape, sole separating at the toe. A length of cord around her waist holds a water bottle and a small shrine-maintenance kit. No jewelry except a twisted bit of copper wire looped around her wrist—a talisman or marker.
